parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the firewall service instance.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: This specifies the incoming L3 interface to which the Service rule applies.

parameters.name: DestPort
parameters.description: Destination port number. A value of ''-1'' indicates this criterion is not used for matching.

parameters.name: IPVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the IP protocol version, following the definitions in {{bibref|IANA-ipversionnumbers}}. Valid values are: {{range}}.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: Protocol number as specified in {{bibref|IANA-protocolnumbers}} For example: * ''6'' (TCP) * ''17'' (UDP) A value of ''-1'' indicates this criterion is not used for matching.

parameters.name: ICMPType
parameters.description: ICMP type as specified in {{bibref|RFC792}} for 'IPv4' and {{bibref|RFC4443}} for 'IPv6'. Only applicable when {{param|Protocol}} contains ''1'' (ICMP IPv4) or ''58'' (ICMP IPv6). A value of ''-1'' indicates this criterion is not used for matching.

parameters.name: SourcePrefixes
parameters.description: Only allow incoming connections that match one or more of the source IP addresses or prefixes that are specified in {{param}} for the applied service.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Action to perform for traffic matching this {{object}} entry.

parameters.name: Log
parameters.description: Enable or disable logging, in a {{object|.DeviceInfo.VendorLogFile}}, of packets matching this {{object}}.

parameters.name: LogRef
parameters.description: Specifies the logging rules for this {{object}} entry. The {{param|Log}} parameter MUST be set to {{true}} for this setting to take effect. When {{param|Log}} is {{true}} and {{param}} is {{empty}} or contains an invalid reference, the system MUST treat the configuration as an error and set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.

object.description: Firewall Service object that is used for configuring the firewall for opening a port/protocol for a local network service. For example: * ''SSH Server'' * ''Web Server'' For enabled table entries, if {{param|Interface}}, {{param|DestPort}} and {{param|Protocol}} are {{empty}}, or if {{param|Interface}} is not a valid reference, then the table entry is inoperable and the device MUST set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.
